title: Cloud Security: tax calculation
content:
Cloud Security tax calculation is governed by these handling clauses.

## Calculation and source basis

The applicable tax classification has an approved system review.

Use the source contract tax treatment reviewed at the service date and reviewed tax rates.

Apply tax to the final rounded net service amount; round tax separately using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention.

For a correction or credit use the original charge tax basis unless an approved tax-error review supplies the corrected treatment.

Tax credits have negative tax amount; charges and upward adjustments have positive tax amount.

Unsupported tax jurisdictions are outside policy coverage, not assumed exempt.

Sum net subtotal and signed tax to obtain the financial amount.

A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

### Authoritative eligibility 1

Before the applicable charge, credit, debit adjustment action, authoritative system records must establish: The applicable tax classification has an approved system review. The evidence is bound to the same Security contract reference.

## Basis Q&A

**Are tax treatments stacked?**

A verified exemption overrides the ordinary taxable rate; there is no stacking of tax treatments.

## Signed tax total

Hypothetical inputs: the final rounded net amount is USD 12 and the separately rounded signed tax is USD 0.96. The financial amount is USD 12.96.
